**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

The agreement meets the **preferred** position: there are no liquidated damages, penalties, or stipulated sums payable by Client.

What I checked:
- **§5 Compensation (p0045, p0047):** fees for requested Hosting/Support Services plus stated monthly minimums during the term; no late fee, interest, or penalty mechanic. §6 actually runs in our favour (documentation rights, dispute rights, one-year price freeze, most-favoured-rate benchmark).
- **§13/§14 Term and Termination (p0078, p0079):** no early-termination fee or minimum-spend recapture. Client gives written notice and services run to the last day of the following month — roughly one month's fees of ordinary wind-down, well inside the 3-month fallback cap even on the most conservative characterisation.
- **§7 / §8f Unsolicited commercial e-mail (p0049, p0058):** a conduct covenant enforced via TrueLink's technical measures and general legal/equitable rights — not a per-incident stipulated penalty, which is the usual risk in this type of clause.
- Document-wide searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "damages", "shall pay", "minimum", "late", "interest" and "per incident" surfaced nothing customer-payable of that character.

No redline proposed.
